ycy tunnel node
Run a remote Tunnel Node management listener
Usage:
  ycy tunnel node [flags]
Flags:
  --data-dir	Private Node state directory
  -h, --help	help for node
  --management-bind-address	Management HTTP bind IP
  --management-port	Management HTTP port
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
